channel.title: KPFK - Law and Disorder
channel.description: What happens when a movement gets a microphone? You get Law & Disorder—a fearless new show on KPFK hosted by longtime organizer, artist, and abolitionist Cat Brooks. This is not your average talk show. Law & Disorder exposes systemic injustice, uplifts movement voices, and agitates for real change. With sharp interviews, cultural insight, and a commitment to truth, this show brings the fire every week.
